Dear Sir,
Concerning "(Old) Bond Street", 61 Nanking Rd., I would
like to give you the following information:
When Mr. Erwin Leschziner liquidated the former partnership
between him and Mr. E. Jellinek in May 1943 he, Leschziner,
offered to a furrier a share in the profit if this furrier
would give him cargo on a credit-basis. This furrier is
Mr. Salomon ARBEIT
599/21, Tongshan Rd., who became through
this arrangement a sort of share in Bond Street, without
my knowledge. At this time, Mr.Arbeit was still employed by me
on my former premises, 20 Nanking Rd. He was my Number One
and had the keys to the workshop.
When I sold the shop to Mr.K.Habu, 24 the Bund, all of us
including Arbeit became employees of Mr.Habu and got Special-
passes.
When Leschziner approached Arbeit, the latter together with
Mr. Arthur ZUCKERMANN and } 599/21, Tongshan Rd.
Mrs. Anna ZUCKERMANN,
(both my former employees and conse-
quently employees of Mr.K.Habu) stole out of my workshop
the pattern for furcoats which are my invention and secret,
and started to make coats for Old Bond Street. Finally not
Arbeit but Zuckermann applied for a furrierlicense because
they wanted Arbeit to keep the specialpass for which he got
by this time the guarantee probably by Salon"Elsie" 133,Bub-
bling Well Rd.

尊敬的先生：
关于南京路61号“（老）邦德街”一事，谨向阁下提供如下信息：
1943年5月，当埃尔温·莱什齐纳（Erwin Leschziner）先生清算其与E.耶利内克（E. Jellinek）先生之前的合伙关系时，莱什齐纳向一位皮货商提出，若该皮货商以赊账方式向他提供货物，则给予其利润分成。这位皮货商是所罗门·阿尔贝特（Salomon ARBEIT）先生，住址为同山路599/21号，他通过此安排在不为我所知的情况下，成为了邦德街某种意义上的股份持有人。当时，阿尔贝特先生仍受雇于我，在我以前的经营场所南京路20号工作。他是我的头号员工，并持有车间的钥匙。
当我将店铺出售给外滩24号的K.哈布（K.Habu）先生时，包括阿尔贝特在内的我们所有人都成为了哈布先生的雇员，并获得了特别通行证。
当莱什齐纳接触阿尔贝特时，后者伙同阿瑟·祖克曼（Arthur ZUCKERMANN）先生及安娜·祖克曼（Anna ZUCKERMANN）夫人（两人均曾是我的雇员，因此也是哈布先生的雇员），从我的车间窃取了属于我发明且保密的皮大衣纸样，并开始为老邦德街制作大衣。最终，申请皮货商执照的不是阿尔贝特，而是祖克曼，因为他们希望阿尔贝特保留其特别通行证，为此他此时可能已得到泡泡井路（Bubbling Well Rd.）133号“艾尔西”（Elsie）沙龙的担保。

I know exactly what I do when I accuse this Trio of
theft and i will stand for the accusation!

When you recently investigated the case of Bond Street,
the next day Arbeit went there, took all his cargo and
gave it to an other salon, probably "Van Lissi" 171 Rte
Sayzoong.

Arbeit and both Zuckermanns are pretending to work for
furruers only. Actually they have a lot of private cus-
tomers and pay practically no taxes.

Should you investigate this case, you might probably
find out a few things more. The facts are:
1.) ARBEIT possesses a specialpass without having a right
to it.
2.) M.A.Zuckermann covers the whole business with his
licence because they fear that the name Arbeit
appears. Arbeit with his specialpass is the
person who controls the different shares.
3.) Mrs.A.Zuckermann has invented the whole plot and is
morally responsible for the theft of the
pattern of which I am the rightfull owner and
consequently Mr.K.Habu.

Through Arbeit you will find out the actual condition
under which E.Leschziner is working in Bond Street be-
cause he is the best friend of Mrs Bauer, the directrice
of Bond Street, who helped to arrange Arbeit's share.

I am sorry I took too much of your time! Should you decide

我在指控这三人盗窃时清楚自己在做什么，并将对此指控负责！

当阁下最近调查邦德街一案时，次日阿尔贝特便前往该处，取走其所有货物，并将其交给另一家沙龙，可能是赛宗路（Rte Sayzoong）171号的“范·利西”（Van Lissi）。

阿尔贝特和两位祖克曼声称仅受雇于皮货商。实际上，他们拥有大量私人客户，且几乎不纳税。

若阁下调查此案，或许能发现更多情况。事实如下：
1.) 阿尔贝特在没有权利的情况下持有特别通行证。
2.) M.A.祖克曼以其执照掩盖整个业务，因为他们担心出现阿尔贝特的名字。持有特别通行证的阿尔贝特是控制不同股份的人。
3.) A.祖克曼夫人策划了整个阴谋，并对窃取纸样负有道德责任，我是该纸样的合法所有者，因此哈布先生也是。

通过阿尔贝特，您将查明E.莱什齐纳在邦德街工作的实际状况，因为他是邦德街女主管鲍尔（Bauer）夫人的挚友，而鲍尔夫人协助安排了阿尔贝特的股份。

抱歉占用了阁下太多时间！若阁下决定
